name: Clarendon
reason: A small hills town; the only draw found is The Farm's Highland cow sessions, a booked, paid operator experience ($200 per group, bookable only), which is a business not a place a visitor can drop into. Fleurieu tourism listings carry the town only as a heading. No Wikivoyage page or guide names a see/do in the town itself.

name: Kyeema Conservation Park
reason: NPWS SA visitor page (free entry, walking trails through regenerating stringybark woodland, 80+ bird species, former prison camp site) plus Fleurieu tourism listing in attractions and nature lists. A 347 ha park with walking trails is a half-hour-plus visit; modest second-tier stop. Objection: no single named walk or lookout, mostly bushwalkers and birders.

name: Mount Bold Reservoir Reserve
reason: SA Water reserve with 13 km of trails (1.4 km return lookout trail to viewing platform, 5 km Forest Loop, 9 km Wedgetail Trail linking Heysen) and a dam-wall lookout; also listed by Fleurieu tourism. Open to public (dam-wall lookout 9am-4pm, no dogs). Objection: reservoir reserve, mostly local recreation.

name: Happy Valley Reservoir Reserve
reason: SA Water reserve with an 11 km Shoreline Loop (about 2.5 hr) and a lookout over the reservoir and dam wall; listed in Fleurieu tourism nature-and-outdoor guide. Public access, walk worth over half an hour. Objection: suburban reserve used mainly by locals.

name: Port Noarlunga Jetty and Aquatic Trail
reason: Listed on southaustralia.com and Fleurieu tourism as Port Noarlunga Beach, Jetty, Reef and Aquatic Trail: jetty, reef sanctuary and an 800 m self-guided underwater snorkel trail with 12 plaques, a well-known Adelaide snorkelling spot. Objection: overlaps a Port Noarlunga Beach/Reef entry if one exists; merge if so.

name: Witton Bluff Base Trail
reason: southaustralia.com attraction page and Fleurieu tourism listing: 1.1 km free, accessible coastal boardwalk under Witton Bluff linking Port Noarlunga and Christies Beach (about 30 min one way), opened 2025. Objection: short, new; reached from the Port Noarlunga jetty area.
